sloka: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।दृष्ट्वा प्रदग्धां तां विस्मयं परमं गताः ।। 5.54.49 ।।।।
transliteration: tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।dṛṣṭvā pradagdhāṁ tāṁ vismayaṁ paramaṁ gatāḥ ।। 5.54.49 ।।।।

translations.english: All beings were afraid of Hanuman thinking that he was the fatal fire, consuming worlds at the hour of dissolution .
